Patti Doss

About the author

Patti Doss is a romance/erotica author and now children's book author from Macon, MS. She is also an avid blogger and she writes relationship articles for an online magazine. She attended and completed college at the prestigious, Mississippi University for Women, with a major in Education. With a writing style that is a mix between urban fiction, erotica, and romance, Patti Doss is breaking the mold in urban romance beyond drug dealers and strippers. Her urban romance novels have a contemporary romance feel with many twists and turns exploring the perplexities of love. She describes her writing style as urban romance mixed with eroticism. She focuses on real-life relationship issues and taboo subjects. Writing is not just a field, she accidentally fell into. She has been writing since she was in the fourth grade.
